TEAN_ID AS 팀코드, PLAYER NAME AS 선수명, POSITION AS 포지션
, 880 0 AS 백넘버, HEIGHT AS 키
FROM PLAYER
WHERE TEAN_ID = '182'
AND POSITION O '바'
ORDER BY 1, 2, 3, 4, 5;
